articles.title: Plan Maker: the numbers behind it

articles.title: Plan Maker: what it does and how to use it
articles.brief: What Plan Maker does — turns a situation into an ordered list of steps with deadlines. Example: 'repair request → 14-day wait → escrow filing' becomes a plan.
